newsitem.title: FRANCE: Light rain over E. France but dry weather returns.
newsitem.headline: Light rain over E. France but dry weather returns.

text.p: Dry and warm weather was back in France on Wednesday with only scattered showers lingering over eastern regions, forecasters said.
"The high pressure system is coming back from the west but there are still a few showers in the east," Meteo France said.
For Thursday sunshine was expected to make a comeback across France apart from a few showers on the Mediterranean island of Corsica and in the mountainous southeast.
The warm and dry weather was expected to persist through Saturday, forecasters said.
Temperatures will be on the rise, reaching an average 23 degrees for the north and 25 degrees for the South on Friday.
Rain over the last five days has brought some relief to thirsty crops but not enough to replenish depleted water tables, forecasters have said.
